definitions.explanation: A seven-day Buddhist memorial period centered on the spring and autumn equinoxes, when Japanese people traditionally visit family graves and make offerings to ancestors.

examples.japanese: お{彼岸|ひがん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{墓参|はかまい}り→墓参り：10663_hakamairi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We visit the grave during higan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{彼岸|ひがん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{牡丹餅|ぼたもち}→牡丹餅：29357_botamochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: We make botamochi (rice cakes) for spring higan.

examples.japanese: お{彼岸|ひがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{供|そな}え{物|もの}→供え物：18160_sonaemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: When higan season comes, offerings are displayed at supermarkets.

notes:
お{彼岸|ひがん} is a Japanese Buddhist observance period.

SEASONS:
- ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{彼岸|ひがん}: Spring higan (around March 20-21)
- ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{彼岸|ひがん}: Autumn higan (around September 22-23)

TRADITIONAL FOODS:
- ⟦{牡丹餅|ぼたもち}→牡丹餅：29357_botamochi⟧: Spring rice cakes (named after peony flowers)
- {御萩|おはぎ}: Autumn rice cakes (named after bush clover)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The equinox is considered a time when the boundary between this world and the afterlife is thinnest. Families visit graves (⟦{墓参|はかまい}り→墓参り：10663_hakamairi⟧), clean tombstones, and make offerings of flowers and food. The expression 「⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{彼岸|ひがん}→彼岸：12612_higan⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧」 means extreme heat and cold end around the equinoxes.
